svg.title: Synapse framework overview
svg.desc: The diagram centers on a conversation in the current workspace, where a human, a native actor, an external IM participant, and a remote agent collaborate. Events and IM messages enter the conversation and wake the corresponding actor; tool calls pass an authorization gate to reach governed workspace resources (plugins, skills, devices, sandboxes); memory, context archiving and pluggable local or cloud-based providers form the substrate.

g.text: your machine, bridged by a daemon
